headline: Fronts Roil as Base Lines Hold Uneasily
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the war’s main struggle concentrated in six unsettled sectors, though the tempo varies sharply by front. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest theater with 51 base events in 24 hours and holdings of five Warden, two Colonial, and two neutral bases; casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating. Nevish Line follows with 42 events, including seven in the latest two-hour watch, and stands at four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. Linn Mercy records 37 events, five recently, with two Warden, eight Colonial, and one neutral position; Lathair remains the chief flashpoint. Mooring County has 22 events and all twelve bases under Warden control, but no events in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow shows 21 exchanges and a divided map of four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base, though its latest activity is several hours old. Stonecradle is quieter in total, yet six events arrived in the latest watch amid rapidly rising casualties, with one Warden and eight Colonial bases. Elsewhere, many fronts report little or no recent base movement.
